scoringCheatSheet.primaryEnergyAndCO2: 40 Points: Verified specific primary energy or CO2-equivalent reduction (>= 15-30% baseline improvement under DIN V 18599 / DIN EN 13031).
scoringCheatSheet.junglandwirteMeisterBonus: +10% Funding Bonus: Certified Gärtnermeister / Landwirtschaftsmeister or qualified young farm successors (<40 years) receive priority ranking.
scoringCheatSheet.resourceCircularity: 30 Points: Closed-loop nutrient/water retention (WHG/DüV compliance) or fossil-free heat integration.

vendorQuoteRules: Mandatory submission of three (3) independent, itemized vendor quotes (Vergleichsangebote) for all capital packages.
Strict Vorhabenbeginn Rule: Signing a purchase order or delivery contract BEFORE receiving the official Zuwendungsbescheid (or vorzeitiger Maßnahmenbeginn approval) triggers 100% forfeiture.
All technical datasheets must state net EUR figures (excluding refundable Umsatzsteuer/VAT) and certified efficiency ratings (COP / umol·J⁻¹ / U-value).
disqualificationPitfalls: Premature Binding Contract (Vorzeitiger Vorhabenbeginn): Even a 10% equipment deposit paid prior to written authority clearance invalidates the entire grant.
Exceeding EU AGVO / De-minimis Caps: Failing to declare cumulative municipal, Länder, and federal (BLE/BAFA/KfW) subsidies on the same invoice.
Missing Certified Energy Advisor Sign-off (EEE-Liste) where energy-efficiency modules are claimed.
applicationPlaybook.stackingRules: Stackable across Regional / State and promotional Rentenbank/KfW credit lines up to statutory EU ABER/AGVO intensity ceilings (typically 40%-65% max public aid; zero double-invoicing of identical cost items).

officialCalculators.description: Statutory program guidelines, scoring rubric, and electronic submission forms published by Stadt Nürnberg — Umweltreferat & N-ERGIE Aktiengesellschaft.

scoringCheatSheet.primaryEnergyAndCO2: 40 Points: Verified specific primary energy or CO2-equivalent reduction (>= 15-30% baseline improvement under DIN V 18599 / DIN EN 13031).
scoringCheatSheet.junglandwirteMeisterBonus: +10% Funding Bonus: Certified Gärtnermeister / Landwirtschaftsmeister or qualified young farm successors (<40 years) receive priority ranking.
scoringCheatSheet.resourceCircularity: 30 Points: Closed-loop nutrient/water retention (WHG/DüV compliance) or fossil-free heat integration.

vendorQuoteRules: Mandatory submission of three (3) independent, itemized vendor quotes (Vergleichsangebote) for all capital packages.
Strict Vorhabenbeginn Rule: Signing a purchase order or delivery contract BEFORE receiving the official Zuwendungsbescheid (or vorzeitiger Maßnahmenbeginn approval) triggers 100% forfeiture.
All technical datasheets must state net EUR figures (excluding refundable Umsatzsteuer/VAT) and certified efficiency ratings (COP / umol·J⁻¹ / U-value).
disqualificationPitfalls: Premature Binding Contract (Vorzeitiger Vorhabenbeginn): Even a 10% equipment deposit paid prior to written authority clearance invalidates the entire grant.
Exceeding EU AGVO / De-minimis Caps: Failing to declare cumulative municipal, Länder, and federal (BLE/BAFA/KfW) subsidies on the same invoice.
Missing Certified Energy Advisor Sign-off (EEE-Liste) where energy-efficiency modules are claimed.
applicationPlaybook.stackingRules: Stackable across Municipal / Local and promotional Rentenbank/KfW credit lines up to statutory EU ABER/AGVO intensity ceilings (typically 40%-65% max public aid; zero double-invoicing of identical cost items).

vendorQuoteRules: All grant disbursements execute strictly through e나라도움 (gosims.go.kr) or 지방보조금 보탬e (losims.go.kr) dedicated subsidy bank accounts.

scoringCheatSheet.resourceConservationEfficiency: 40 Points: Quantified irrigation water savings (acre-feet/yr), nutrient runoff reduction, or >= 20-30% farm energy savings verified for US Federal — USDA NRCS EQIP (Practices 325 / 441 / 374).
scoringCheatSheet.priorityProducerBonus: +10-15 Points: Beginning Farmers (<10 yrs), Socially Disadvantaged, Veteran Farmers, or operations in priority watersheds / non-attainment basins.
scoringCheatSheet.budgetReadinessAndMatch: 30 Points: Itemized turnkey vendor bids, confirmed landowner lease/deed control, and clear cost-share documentation.

vendorQuoteRules: Obtain minimum two to three (2-3) independent, itemized written vendor quotes dated within 90 days of application filing.

Maintain active SAM.gov Unique Entity Identifier (UEI — free registration; never pay third-party fee mills) and USDA FSA Farm & Tract Number (Form AD-1026 wetland/HEL compliance) where federal pass-through funds apply.
Energy efficiency upgrades > $200k typically require an ASHRAE Level II / ASABE S612 farm energy audit prior to award.
disqualificationPitfalls: Retroactive Purchase Violation: Ordering equipment, signing binding POs, or breaking ground BEFORE receiving a fully executed Grant Agreement / NRCS CPA-1202 contract.
Inactive SAM.gov UEI or missing IRS Form W-9 / State Vendor Payee registration at solicitation deadline.
Substituting unapproved equipment capacities after technical merit scoring without written grant officer amendment.
applicationPlaybook.stackingRules: Can be layered with federal IRA Investment Tax Credits (Section 48/48E 30% ITC), utility ag-pump/LED rebates, and USDA FSA low-interest microloans/equipment loans, provided identical cost-share dollars are never double-counted above 100% project cost.

name: New Mexico Agricultural Solar Market Development Tax Credit (10%) + NMDA/SWCD On-Farm Drip & CEA Thermal
agency: New Mexico Energy, Minerals and Natural Resources Department (EMNRD) & NMDA Soil and Water Conservation
subsidyType: State Refundable Solar Tax Credit + SWCD Water Cost-Share
subsidyRate: 10% NM State Solar Credit (Stacks on 30% Federal ITC = 40%!) + Up to 75% SWCD Drip/Micro-Irrigation Cost-Share
maxAmount: $6,000 Direct State Tax Credit per System + Up to $50,000 SWCD / Water Trust Cost-Share
matchRequirement: Stacks directly with 50% USDA REAP + 30% Federal ITC (Covering up to 85%-90% of Ag Solar!)
selectionMethod: Technical Efficiency Threshold & Statutory Eligibility Audit
targetEquipment: Agricultural solar PV arrays powering deep-well drip pumps, pecan/chile cold storage, and greenhouses
Solar thermal collectors and phase-change / hydronic buffer tanks for high-desert winter greenhouses
Subsurface drip irrigation (SDI) and acequia/well flow-metering telemetry via local SWCDs
ineligibleItems: Retroactive equipment orders placed prior to official grant approval / Vorhabenbeginn clearance
Used or uncertified secondhand machinery without OEM efficiency warranty
Routine consumable inputs (fertilizer salts, seeds, growing media, seasonal labor)
qualificationCriteria: Agricultural or horticultural property in New Mexico inspected by NM Construction Industries Division (CID)
System installed by certified contractor meeting NEC / utility interconnection standards
documentChecklist: NM CID final electrical/building inspection pass certificate & utility PTO letter
Itemized solar/irrigation EPC invoice and New Mexico TRD tax credit certificate
portalName: NM EMNRD Clean Energy Tax Portal & Local Soil and Water Conservation District
summary: High-irradiance Southwest capital stack for Rio Grande chile/pecan irrigators and high-altitude New Mexico passive-solar greenhouses: combines NM's refundable 10% Solar Market Development Tax Credit with 50% USDA REAP, 30% Federal ITC, and local SWCD drip-irrigation cost-share.
deepGuide: Step 1: Verify annual EMNRD SMDTC cap availability and use NM CID-certified solar installer. Step 2: File USDA REAP BEFORE solar construction starts, then claim NM 10% credit + Federal ITC post-interconnection.

scoringCheatSheet.resourceConservationEfficiency: 40 Points: Quantified irrigation water savings (acre-feet/yr), nutrient runoff reduction, or >= 20-30% farm energy savings verified for New Mexico Ag Clean Energy, Solar Pumping & Water Grants.
scoringCheatSheet.priorityProducerBonus: +10-15 Points: Beginning Farmers (<10 yrs), Socially Disadvantaged, Veteran Farmers, or operations in priority watersheds / non-attainment basins.
scoringCheatSheet.budgetReadinessAndMatch: 30 Points: Itemized turnkey vendor bids, confirmed landowner lease/deed control, and clear cost-share documentation.

vendorQuoteRules: Obtain minimum two to three (2-3) independent, itemized written vendor quotes dated within 90 days of application filing.

Maintain active SAM.gov Unique Entity Identifier (UEI — free registration; never pay third-party fee mills) and USDA FSA Farm & Tract Number (Form AD-1026 wetland/HEL compliance) where federal pass-through funds apply.
Energy efficiency upgrades > $200k typically require an ASHRAE Level II / ASABE S612 farm energy audit prior to award.
disqualificationPitfalls: Retroactive Purchase Violation: Ordering equipment, signing binding POs, or breaking ground BEFORE receiving a fully executed Grant Agreement / NRCS CPA-1202 contract.
Inactive SAM.gov UEI or missing IRS Form W-9 / State Vendor Payee registration at solicitation deadline.
Substituting unapproved equipment capacities after technical merit scoring without written grant officer amendment.
